take: New Jersey announced it acquired goalie Connor Hellebuyck from Winnipeg for forwards Dawson Mercer, Alexander Command and Nick Bjugstad, goalie Nicolas Daws, a 2029 second-round pick and a 2027 seventh-round pick. The Devils are 6-4-0, controlling 58.6% of expected goals (a measure of chance quality), yet their goaltending has saved 5.3 goals fewer than expected, which is the gap Hellebuyck is arriving to fill. Mercer has no goals and four assists in 10 games, though the team's expected-goal share dips 9.2 points when he is on the ice. We have no numbers on the other players or Hellebuyck.
